description: Defines the FileSystemMonitor class for monitoring file system changes across different platforms (Apple, Linux, Windows). Includes nested classes for callbacks, observers, and platform-specific implementations for file system event handling.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor
classes.description: Monitors file system changes, platform-specific implementations for Linux/Apple (kqueue/inotify) and Windows (ReadDirectoryChangesW).

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback objects to be notified of file system updates.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Observer
classes.description: Manages callbacks for a specific file or directory, used internally within FileSystemMonitor.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Context
classes.description: Platform-specific class for handling directory change notifications (Windows).

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Dispatcher
classes.description: Thread class for processing file system events asynchronously (Windows).

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the monitor is properly initialized.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a callback for a specific file or directory.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a callback from a specific file or directory.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers the event to wake the processing thread (Windows).
